$comment: Which moonbase Skill file goes with which tool. skill/build.mjs writes each file from skill/moonbase/; the /skill page renders this table. Edit here, then run skill/package.sh.

adapters.use: Claude Code: put the moonbase/ folder in .claude/skills/. Claude apps: upload moonbase.skill as a custom skill.

adapters.tools: Codex CLI, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Gemini CLI, Copilot agent mode and other tools that read AGENTS.md
adapters.use: Put AGENTS.md in your project's root folder (or add its text to the one you have). Short instructions (about 6 KB, loaded every session) that point to the full guide, read on demand.
Save as .cursor/rules/moonbase.mdc in your project. The full guide (about 70 KB), loaded only when the conversation is about hosting or moonbase.
Paste into your project's CLAUDE.md (about 6 KB). It points Claude Code to the full guide, read on demand; put moonbase-guide.md in the project too to read it offline.
Save as .github/copilot-instructions.md in your repository (or add its text to yours). Short instructions (about 6 KB, loaded every session) that point to the full guide, read on demand.
Create a GPT: paste instructions.txt into Instructions and upload moonbase-guide.md under Knowledge.
Create a Gem: paste gem-instructions.md into its instructions and add moonbase-guide.md as a knowledge file.
Attach moonbase-guide.md, or paste it as your first message.
